Maya: Customer BlueNova says their API credential shows up in the console but all requests return 403. Can someone take a quick look?
Devon: Which credential ID? Do we have their org/project?
Maya: cred id 01G8ZXKJ2, org blue-nova, project blue-nova-prod. They signed up via OIDC. They see the key in console UI under Projects > blue-nova-prod.
Irina: Can you paste the exact curl and response?
Maya: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer 01G8ZXKJ2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"forbidden","message":"API key not authorized for project 'blue-nova-prod'"}
Maya: They tried with our SDK too. Same 403.
Devon: Huh. Console shows it, but backend says not authorized. Could be claim binding stuck (staged) or wrong tenant mapping. I can check provisioner logs.
ProvisionerBot: [provisioner] claim status update for cred 01G8ZXKJ2 -> STAGED (created 2026-02-14T10:02:03Z)
Devon: That bot message suggests the claim never transitioned to BOUND. @Irina can you search for errors in the claim syncer for that time window?
Irina: Looking... I see an error: "claim binding failed: org lookup mismatch: tenant_id 0xABC != expected 0xABCD" followed by retry. The provisioner retried 6 times then left it STAGED.
Maya: So UI shows the key because the console just surfaces the credential record, not the binding state. We should tell the customer that the cred exists but isn't bound to the runtime project.
Devon: Agreed. For a quick fix I can force-bind the claim (manual reconcile). Steps: 1) verify tenant_id and project mapping, 2) run admin tool: 
```
adminctl claim bind --cred 01G8ZXKJ2 --project blue-nova-prod --force
```
Then re-issue cache invalidation for auth cache.
Chris: Before forcing, let's confirm why tenant_id mismatched. Could be SSO mapping delay. Any recent IdP/SCIM changes for BlueNova?
Irina: Customer notes: they changed their org display name right before onboarding. The OIDC sub stayed the same. I see a brief 30s window where our mapping service returned the old tenant_id. The provisioner picked that and created a claim tied to the old tenant record, which no longer maps to blue-nova-prod.
Maya: Customer is in a P0 trial and needs this live for a demo in 3 hours. What's ETA on manual bind?
Devon: If I run the admin bind now and confirm auth cache invalidation, it should be <10 minutes. I'll do it and report back.
Maya: Thanks. I'll tell the customer we expect a ~10m fix.
Devon: Running bind now...
ProvisionerBot: [provisioner] admin action: claim 01G8ZXKJ2 force-bound to project blue-nova-prod by devon at 2026-02-14T10:12:01Z
Devon: Invalidation kicked. Please try again.
Maya: Customer confirms: requests now return 200, demo green. :tada:
Chris: We'll need a follow-up: 1) patch the provisioner to handle transient tenant_id mismatches with a guarded reconcile, 2) surface claim binding state in console more obviously (STAGED vs BOUND), 3) add an alert when claims stay STAGED > 2m.
Irina: Filed infra ticket INF-4821 with logs and repro steps.
Maya: Thanks all, closing with customer now.
Devon: Leaving notes on the cred record and adding postmortem entry.
Maya: Closing thread.
